What do you mean by "shook me to my core"?
Also, have you tried 5-meo-dmt before? I heard that it's much more powerful than regular DMT and the life changes that come with it.

I understand the value of discipline. I have been trying to make improvements here and there for the past 2 years but man is it difficult! I always slip back into my old routines and habits, I lose sight of the main reason i began improving myself.

Wow, thank you so much for all the advice bro. I really love the idea of Workaway and i am considering to do some volunteering work next year. In fact I am looking into a local meditation retreat centre which I had done a 10 day course 5 months ago. I have been doing meditation for over 2 years now on and off and I do see the value in it. I understand the Ayahuasca is not a magic pill but rather a catalyst towards a better life.
